notes_for_editor: Story is about 80 words, below the 120-word floor, because the only history is one Forest Lookouts entry (build year, height, steel construction) plus a coordinate listing. Searches (two used) and cached pages gave no later history, status, or access for the High Peak tower. The Forest Lookouts source prints the year as '1 934'; read as 1934, not verified. A 1985 wildfire, the High Peak Fire, burned Mineral Springs and destroyed 27 homes (morganton.com, Burke County); no source ties it to the lookout, so it is left out. The Forest Lookouts entry gives no later history. Brief status unknown, left as is. Next leads: NC Forest Service or Peter Barr's book on the state's towers; Facebook group posts about Burke towers could not be read.
